use_when: as the main navigation on every dashboard screen.
Group items under section labels, such as Main and Insights.
Set exactly one item to Active: the page you are on.
Use an expandable item when a page has sub-pages, and show them as sub-items.

dont_use_when.when: on the customer website or mobile app.
with more than one level of sub-items.
Do not mark more than one item as Active.
Do not use different icons for the same page in different places.

best_practice: Use the same page names as the page titles and the breadcrumb.
Keep labels short, one to three words, so they do not get cut off.
Keep about 7 items or fewer per section.

variant_intent.state=Active: Figma: the page you are on; exactly one item.
variant_intent.expand=None: Renders the item as a link (code).
variant_intent.expand=Collapsed: Renders the item as a disclosure button, collapsed (code).
variant_intent.expand=Expanded: Renders the item as a disclosure button, expanded (code).

placement: The Sidebar stays fixed on the left at full height, with the Top Bar and page content to its right.

a11y.fact: Navigation sits in a <nav> landmark, named "Main" by default.
The Active item is marked aria-current="page".
Expandable items are buttons with aria-expanded.
Items show a focus ring on keyboard focus.
